components.description: Contributor browser/device; can read its authorized local content; compromised device remains a threat.
Web host/CDN/TLS termination; sees network metadata; must not cache private responses.
Purpose-scoped intake/case/authorization boundary; managed processing can read permitted plaintext.
Private database and backup processor; managed keys/operators are not proven blind.
Private original object storage; encryption-at-rest is not end-to-end encryption.
Isolated scan/transcode/redaction processor; reads only leased objects in managed mode.
Assigned support/editorial recipient; field/asset authorization and auditable decisions required.
Named recipient with contributor-approved, expiring resource grants; no role-wide case access.
Release boundary checking current consent, approval, classification and safe derivatives atomically.
Approved public tables, media/CDN, search and social previews; no restricted payloads.
Any public visitor, crawler or outside copier; copies cannot reliably be recalled.
Authentication/session processor; do not conflate authentication with case grants.
Optional delivery provider; receives contact/routing metadata, never private story payloads.
Operational metrics/error processor; minimized metadata only, no confidential content.
Justice For All identity/navigation integration; no implicit political/donor or case linkage.
FOIA/public citation system; external public metadata only, no private evidence write access.
Optional Liberty Nodes recipient; authorized public export may persist after withdrawal.
Scoped infrastructure operator; potential managed-key/data access must be assessed, not hidden.
Unselected key custody mechanism; compartment/key-role and recovery tests remain required.

negativeScenarios.trigger: EXIF/voice/face/exact-date and caption clues remain in candidate
negativeScenarios.expected: Block release for redaction review; preserve private original; do not guarantee anonymity.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Core SSO or donor ID is used to enroll/link a case participant
negativeScenarios.expected: Deny implicit linkage/enrollment; require separate voluntary consent and distinct purpose.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Consent revoked or derivative replaced while release is queued
negativeScenarios.expected: Abort complete projection; require current version/approvals and no retry resurrection.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Error payload, email subject or URL preview contains private narrative
negativeScenarios.expected: Reject confidential metadata export; use redacted structured error and generic notice.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Helper requests unrelated, expired, newly added or revoked resource
negativeScenarios.expected: Deny at API and storage; no inherited grants; audit without content leakage.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Managed server-readable processing is advertised as E2EE or anonymous network access
negativeScenarios.expected: Suppress unsupported claim; disabled profile stays disabled; label managed processing honestly.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Scanner unavailable, parser timeout, archive bomb or injected metadata
negativeScenarios.expected: Remain quarantined; enforce isolation/resource limits; no direct public URL.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Publication consent is reused for distributed replication
negativeScenarios.expected: Reject export absent separate current replication consent and warn outside-copy limits.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Administrator or helper role alone requests identity/key compartment
negativeScenarios.expected: Deny without separate permitted recipient/dual-control authorization; no broad key access.

negativeScenarios.trigger: Guess a receipt ID or replay another principal session
negativeScenarios.expected: No case existence disclosure or access; require valid scoped proof/session.

limitations: Design coverage is not a complete source/build/runtime E2EESA inventory or conformance verdict.
No live service, key provider, processing vendor or retention schedule is established.
Potential plaintext-capable actors identify exposure, not authorization; every actual access still requires scope and consent.
Actual data/keys in backups, error paths, browser storage and provider control planes require implementation-bound assessment.
